Name: Dizor's Wizard Redraw for SVE (by Handie)
Author: TheBlackHand13
Description:
[b][u]Dizor's Wizard Redraw for SVE (by Handie)[/u][/b]

Original portrait by Dizor, you can find the original mod here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/74]Dizor's Wizard Redraw[/url]


[b][u]But why tho[/u][/b]
I really liked Dizor's portraits of Magnus, but they only changed the vanilla .xmb files, which made them incompatible with SVE, which adds a lot more content for Magnus and includes a full range of NPC expressions, in contrast to the base game only including 2 unique expressions for Magnus.
All I've done here is taken Dizor's 2 base expressions and carefully crafted the other 5 used by SVE, while trying to stay true to Dizor's original artwork as closely as possible, with a couple of my own tweaks based on preference.

There is another mod that does something similar for SVE but it requires Seasonal Outfits and uses the Siv's Marriage Mod portraits of him; I don't use SO and the SMM portraits really aren't my favorite. But if that mod sounds more like what you're looking for, you can find it here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12108]Dizor's Seasonal Wizard - Vanilla and SVE[/url]

So who needs this mod?
Basically if you're like me and you use SVE and you like Dizor's portraits but don't want a wizard whose hair color changes seasonally

Just unpack the .zip in your mods folder and allow the mod to overwrite.

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and all of its dependencies.

While you're at it, maybe check out my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17248]Handie's Beard
[/url]It makes it so you can still wear beards with all your other Fashion Sense accessories. Go figure.
